stock.description: BOC Aviation Limited, along with its affiliated entities, functions worldwide as a company specializing in the operating lease of aircraft. It delivers a comprehensive array of services to airlines and aircraft owners, which include direct operating leases, sale and leaseback arrangements, and the management of third-party assets. The firm also offers aircraft remarketing and technical oversight services to a diverse client base, such as airlines, financial institutions, and other investors. Additionally, BOC Aviation facilitates debt funding and various other financial solutions for airlines and aircraft investors, and is involved in the direct sale of aircraft. As of December 31, 2021, its extensive fleet consisted of 521 aircraft, comprising those it owned, managed, and had on order. Established in 1993, the company maintains its principal office in Singapore and operates as a subsidiary of Sky Splendor Limited.
